scientific_conclusion.candidate_decision: Do not advance PCDE-PS as the current MICCAI 2027 second-module candidate; no additional groups or tuning were run.
scientific_conclusion.text_intervention: Medical-to-anonymous mean absolute ASD-probability change 0.000126253, maximum 0.002717137, zero hard flips; normal/abnormal side swap mean absolute change 0.000089072, maximum 0.001512229, zero hard flips.
scientific_conclusion.gate_intervention: Setting gate to one changed mean absolute ASD probability by 0.000419358 and caused one harmful hard flip; G3 is 0.1149 pp ACC below G2.
scientific_conclusion.limitations: Inherited test-as-validation selection, pre-CV RFE/standardization, transductive graph and Fold-2 train/test overlap remain.
